{{Quote|Approaching transport, this is Razor Leader of the Thaereian Navy; you are approaching a restricted access area. Hold your position and identify yourself.|Razor Leader|<ref name="Force Convention">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Convention}}</ref>}}
'''Razor Leader''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Thaereian military]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Razor Leader flew a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] and commanded a number of others. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was sent to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and assigned to protect the ''[[Luxury]]'', a luxurious liner which was being used for a peace conference.

Using the alias "Lernia", the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] informed Razor Leader that someone was going to board ''The Luxury'' and sabotage the conference. When the [[Heroes of Cularin]] tried to land their ship on the liner, Razor Leader initially tried to prevent them from doing so, although they eventually persuaded him to let them land.
